questions.prompt: A boat heads due east at 15 km/h in still water while a river current flows due north at 36 km/h. Find the speed of the boat relative to the ground (km/h).
questions.explanation: The two velocities are perpendicular, so the resultant speed is \(\sqrt{15^2+36^2}=\sqrt{1521}=39\) km/h.

questions.prompt: Find the unit vector in the direction of \(\vec a=8\hat i-4\hat j+8\hat k\).
questions.explanation: \(|\vec a|=12\), so \(\hat a=\dfrac{\vec a}{|\vec a|}=\dfrac{1}{12}(8\hat i-4\hat j+8\hat k)=\frac{2}{3}\hat i-\frac{1}{3}\hat j+\frac{2}{3}\hat k\).

questions.prompt: Find the projection (scalar component) of \(\vec b=-4\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\) along \(\vec a=-10\hat i+10\hat j-5\hat k\).
questions.explanation: Projection of \(\vec b\) along \(\vec a\) \(=\dfrac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec a|}=\dfrac{45}{15}=3\).

questions.prompt: Find \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) for \(A(0, 1, 2)\) and \(B(-1, 0, 3)\).
questions.explanation: Head − Tail: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=B-A=(-1, 0, 3)-(0, 1, 2)=-\hat i-\hat j+\hat k\).

questions.prompt: The point \(P\) divides \(\overline{AB}\) internally in the ratio \(AP:PB=3:1\), where \(A(-2, -2, 2)\) and \(B(10, -10, 6)\). Find \(\overrightarrow{OP}\).
questions.explanation: \(\vec r=\dfrac{n\vec a+m\vec b}{m+n}=\dfrac{1(-2, -2, 2)+3(10, -10, 6)}{4}=7\hat i-8\hat j+5\hat k\). (The second vector \(\vec b\) is multiplied by the first number \(m\).)

questions.prompt: Find the area of the triangle with vertices \((-1, -2)\), \((1, -4)\), \((2, 0)\).
questions.explanation: Treat the points as \((x,y,0)\). \(\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}=10\hat k\), so the area is \(\tfrac12|10|=5\).

questions.prompt: The point \(P\) divides \(\overline{AB}\) externally in the ratio \(AP:PB=4:3\), where \(A(4, 2, 2)\) and \(B(7, 4, 3)\). Find \(\overrightarrow{OP}\).
questions.explanation: External division: \(\vec r=\dfrac{m\vec b-n\vec a}{m-n}=\dfrac{4(7, 4, 3)-3(4, 2, 2)}{1}=16\hat i+10\hat j+6\hat k\).

questions.prompt: Find \(\sin\theta\), where \(\theta\) is the angle between \(\vec a=-8\hat i-4\hat j-8\hat k\) and \(\vec b=-4\hat i-8\hat j+8\hat k\).
questions.explanation: \(\sin\theta=\dfrac{|\vec a\times\vec b|}{|\vec a||\vec b|}\). \(\vec a\times\vec b=-96\hat i+96\hat j+48\hat k\), \(|\vec a|=12\), \(|\vec b|=12\), so \(\sin\theta=1\).

questions.prompt: Find the distance between \(P(2, -3, -3)\) and \(Q(4, -12, 3)\).
Find the moment of the force \(\vec F=2\hat i-4\hat j+2\hat k\) acting at the point \(P(4, 4, -4)\) about the origin.
questions.explanation: \(\vec r=\overrightarrow{OP}=P-O=4\hat i+4\hat j-4\hat k\); \(\vec M=\vec r\times\vec F=-8\hat i-16\hat j-24\hat k\). (Order matters: \(\vec r\) first, then \(\vec F\).)

questions.prompt: For which value of \(t\) are \(A(3, 0, -4)\), \(B(1, 1, -1)\) and \(C(-3, 3, t)\) collinear?
questions.explanation: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=-2\hat i+\hat j+3\hat k\) and \(\overrightarrow{AC}\) must be parallel to it. The first two components give \(\overrightarrow{AC}=3\,\overrightarrow{AB}\), so \(t=z_A+3(3)=5\).

questions.prompt: If \(\vec a=-5\hat i-2\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\vec b=4\hat i+3\hat j-2\hat k\), find \(\vec a-1\vec b\).
questions.explanation: Multiply component by component then add: \(1(-5, -2, -1)-1(4, 3, -2)=-9\hat i-5\hat j+\hat k\).

questions.prompt: A boat heads due east at 50 km/h in still water while a river current flows due north at 120 km/h. Find the speed of the boat relative to the ground (km/h).
questions.explanation: The two velocities are perpendicular, so the resultant speed is \(\sqrt{50^2+120^2}=\sqrt{16900}=130\) km/h.

questions.prompt: For which value of \(t\) are \(A(-4, -4, 2)\), \(B(-6, -5, -1)\) and \(C(-10, -7, t)\) collinear?
questions.explanation: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=-2\hat i-\hat j-3\hat k\) and \(\overrightarrow{AC}\) must be parallel to it. The first two components give \(\overrightarrow{AC}=3\,\overrightarrow{AB}\), so \(t=z_A+3(-3)=-7\).

questions.prompt: Find the moment of the force \(\vec F=\hat i-\hat j+3\hat k\) acting at the point \(P(-2, 0, 2)\) about the origin.
questions.explanation: \(\vec r=\overrightarrow{OP}=P-O=-2\hat i+2\hat k\); \(\vec M=\vec r\times\vec F=2\hat i+8\hat j+2\hat k\). (Order matters: \(\vec r\) first, then \(\vec F\).)

questions.prompt: A force of magnitude 10 N acts on a body and displaces it by 5 m. The angle between the force and the displacement is \(180^\circ\). Find the work done in joules.
questions.explanation: \(W=Fd\cos\theta=10\times5\times\cos180^\circ=-50\) J.

questions.prompt: The vectors \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) are coplanar. Then the parallelepiped on them has volume
questions.explanation: Coplanar edges give a flat solid, with no volume.

questions.prompt: If \([\vec a\ \vec b\ \vec c]=-8\), find \([\vec b\ \vec a\ \vec c]\).
questions.explanation: A cyclic shift of the three vectors keeps the sign; swapping any two vectors changes the sign; a repeated vector makes the value \(0\).

questions.prompt: A stone is thrown with initial speed 60 m/s at \(30^\circ\) above the horizontal. Find its horizontal velocity component (m/s).
questions.explanation: \(v_x=u\cos\phi=60\cos30^\circ=30 \sqrt{3}\) m/s (constant, since no horizontal force acts).

questions.prompt: Find \(\vec a\cdot\vec b\) if \(\vec a=-3\hat i+2\hat j+2\hat k\) and \(\vec b=2\hat i-\hat j+2\hat k\).
If \(|\vec a|=3\), \(|\vec b|=4\) and the angle between them is \(60^\circ\), find \(|\vec a-\vec b|\).
questions.explanation: \(|\vec a-\vec b|^2=|\vec a|^2-2\vec a\cdot\vec b+|\vec b|^2=9-2(6)+16=13\), so \(|\vec a-\vec b|=\sqrt{13}\).

questions.prompt: If \([\vec a\ \vec b\ \vec c]=7\), find \([\vec b\ \vec a\ \vec c]\).
questions.explanation: A cyclic shift of the three vectors keeps the sign; swapping any two vectors changes the sign; a repeated vector makes the value \(0\).

questions.prompt: Find the coefficient of \(\hat j\) in \(\vec a\times\vec b\) when \(\vec a=-3\hat i+2\hat j+4\hat k\) and \(\vec b=3\hat i+\hat k\).
questions.explanation: \(\vec a\times\vec b=2\hat i+15\hat j-6\hat k\); the coefficient of \(\hat j\) is \(15\). (For \(\hat j\) remember the minus sign in the determinant.)

questions.prompt: Find \(\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c\) for \(\vec a=-\hat i-2\hat j-2\hat k\), \(\vec b=3\hat i+\hat j\), \(\vec c=\hat i-\hat j-3\hat k\).
questions.explanation: \(\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c=\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2&-2\\3&1&0\\1&-1&-3\end{vmatrix}=-7\).

questions.prompt: Find \(\vec a\cdot\vec b\) if \(\vec a=-3\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\hat i-\hat j-3\hat k\).
Which vector is parallel to \(\vec a=\hat i+2\hat j-4\hat k\)?
questions.explanation: Parallel vectors are scalar multiples: \(\vec b=k\vec a\). Only \(-3\hat i-6\hat j+12\hat k=-3\vec a\) has all three ratios equal to \(-3\).

questions.prompt: \(ABCD\) is a parallelogram (vertices in this order) with \(A(-2, 5, -3)\), \(B(4, 2, 3)\), \(C(5, 3, 2)\). Find \(D\).
questions.explanation: The diagonals bisect each other, so \(\dfrac{\vec a+\vec c}{2}=\dfrac{\vec b+\vec d}{2}\) and \(\vec d=\vec a+\vec c-\vec b=-\hat i+6\hat j-4\hat k\).

questions.prompt: Find the position vector of the centroid of the triangle with vertices \(A(4, -4, 0)\), \(B(2, 1, 4)\), \(C(0, 3, -1)\).
questions.explanation: The centroid divides each median in the ratio \(2:1\): \(\vec g=\dfrac{\vec a+\vec b+\vec c}{3}=\dfrac{(6, 0, 3)}{3}=2\hat i+\hat k\).

questions.prompt: \(ABCD\) is a parallelogram (vertices in this order) with \(A(-5, 4, 4)\), \(B(-4, 3, -4)\), \(C(-3, -5, 0)\). Find \(D\).
questions.explanation: The diagonals bisect each other, so \(\dfrac{\vec a+\vec c}{2}=\dfrac{\vec b+\vec d}{2}\) and \(\vec d=\vec a+\vec c-\vec b=-4\hat i-4\hat j+8\hat k\).

questions.prompt: Which unit vector is perpendicular to both \(\vec a=-\hat i-\hat k\) and \(\vec b=-\hat i+2\hat j\)? (One of the two possible answers is listed.)
questions.explanation: \(\vec a\times\vec b=2\hat i+\hat j-2\hat k\) is perpendicular to both; its magnitude is \(3\). Divide by it: \(\frac{2}{3}\hat i+\frac{1}{3}\hat j-\frac{2}{3}\hat k\) (the negative of this is the other unit vector).

questions.prompt: Find the position vector of the centroid of the triangle with vertices \(A(-4, 2, 5)\), \(B(1, 1, -1)\), \(C(3, -3, 2)\).
questions.explanation: The centroid divides each median in the ratio \(2:1\): \(\vec g=\dfrac{\vec a+\vec b+\vec c}{3}=\dfrac{(0, 0, 6)}{3}=2\hat k\).

questions.prompt: Find the area of the triangle with vertices \(A(3, 0, -3)\), \(B(3, 1, -4)\), \(C(3, 4, 1)\).
questions.explanation: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=\hat j-\hat k\), \(\overrightarrow{AC}=4\hat j+4\hat k\); \(\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}=8\hat i\). Area \(=\tfrac12|\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}|=\tfrac12\sqrt{64}=4\).

questions.prompt: Find \(\lambda\) so that \(\vec a=-2\hat i-\hat j+3\hat k\), \(\vec b=3\hat i+2\hat j-2\hat k\), \(\vec c=-2\hat j+\lambda\hat k\) are coplanar.
questions.explanation: Coplanar \(\Leftrightarrow\) \(\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c=0\). Expanding the determinant gives \(- lam - 10=0\), so \(\lambda=-10\).

questions.prompt: The point \(P\) divides \(\overline{AB}\) externally in the ratio \(AP:PB=5:3\), where \(A(0, -2, 4)\) and \(B(6, 0, -2)\). Find \(\overrightarrow{OP}\).
questions.explanation: External division: \(\vec r=\dfrac{m\vec b-n\vec a}{m-n}=\dfrac{5(6, 0, -2)-3(0, -2, 4)}{2}=15\hat i+3\hat j-11\hat k\).

questions.prompt: The point \((-2, 2, 6)\) lies in the octant where
questions.explanation: The signs of the coordinates are \(x\) negative, \(y\) positive, \(z\) positive, so the octant is \(x<0, y>0, z>0\).

questions.prompt: Find the direction cosines \((l, m, n)\) of \(\vec r=-6\hat i+6\hat j+7\hat k\).
Find the moment of the force \(\vec F=-2\hat j+3\hat k\) acting at the point \(P(4, 0, 3)\) about the origin.
questions.explanation: \(\vec r=\overrightarrow{OP}=P-O=4\hat i+3\hat k\); \(\vec M=\vec r\times\vec F=6\hat i-12\hat j-8\hat k\). (Order matters: \(\vec r\) first, then \(\vec F\).)

questions.prompt: The work done is negative when the angle between force and displacement is
questions.explanation: \(\cos\theta<0\) for \(90^\circ<\theta<180^\circ\).

questions.prompt: The point \((-1, 0, 0)\) lies on
questions.explanation: Count the zero coordinates: a point with one zero coordinate lies in a coordinate plane (the zero coordinate names the plane it is perpendicular to), and a point with two zero coordinates lies on an axis.

questions.prompt: Find the area of the triangle with vertices \((-1, 0)\), \((3, -3)\), \((1, -3)\).
questions.explanation: Treat the points as \((x,y,0)\). \(\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}=-6\hat k\), so the area is \(\tfrac12|-6|=3\).

questions.prompt: Find the area of the parallelogram whose adjacent sides are \(\vec a=3\hat i-3\hat k\) and \(\vec b=-4\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k\).
questions.explanation: Area \(=|\vec a\times\vec b|\). \(\vec a\times\vec b=6\hat i+3\hat j+6\hat k\), so area \(=\sqrt{81}=9\).

questions.prompt: The point \((-6, 6, 0)\) lies on
questions.explanation: Count the zero coordinates: a point with one zero coordinate lies in a coordinate plane (the zero coordinate names the plane it is perpendicular to), and a point with two zero coordinates lies on an axis.

questions.prompt: \(\vec a=3\hat i-2\hat j-4\hat k\), \(\vec b=-3\hat i+3\hat j+\hat k\). The angle between them is
questions.explanation: \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=-19\). Positive dot product \(\Rightarrow\) acute angle, zero \(\Rightarrow\) \(90^\circ\), negative \(\Rightarrow\) obtuse.

questions.prompt: Find \(\lambda\) so that \(4\hat i-4\hat j+\lambda\hat k\) is perpendicular to \(\hat i+3\hat j-\hat k\).
questions.explanation: Perpendicular \(\Leftrightarrow\) dot product \(=0\): \(4(1)+(-4)(3)+\lambda(-1)=0\Rightarrow\lambda=-8\).

questions.prompt: If \([\vec a\ \vec b\ \vec c]=8\), find \([\vec b\ \vec c\ \vec a]\).
questions.explanation: A cyclic shift of the three vectors keeps the sign; swapping any two vectors changes the sign; a repeated vector makes the value \(0\).

questions.prompt: Find the volume of the parallelepiped with adjacent edges \(\vec a=-2\hat i+\hat j+2\hat k\), \(\vec b=-\hat i+\hat j-3\hat k\), \(\vec c=-\hat i-3\hat j-2\hat k\).
questions.explanation: Volume \(=|\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c|\). The determinant is \(31\); volume (never negative) \(=31\) cubic units.

questions.prompt: A force of 20 N is applied at a distance of 3 m from a hinge. The angle between the force and the line from the hinge to the point of application is \(30^\circ\). Find the magnitude of the moment (N m).
questions.explanation: \(|\vec M|=|\vec r||\vec F|\sin\theta=3\times20\times\sin30^\circ=30\) N m.

questions.prompt: For the scalar triple product, which is TRUE?
questions.explanation: The dot and the cross may be interchanged; swapping two vectors changes the sign.

options: \(\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c\) is always positive
\(\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c=\vec a\times\vec b\cdot\vec c\)
\(\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c=\vec a\cdot\vec c\times\vec b\)
\(\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c=\vec b\cdot\vec a\times\vec c\)

questions.prompt: If \(|\vec a|=2\), \(|\vec b|=6\) and \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=-9\), find \(|\vec a\times\vec b|^2\).
questions.explanation: Lagrange identity: \(|\vec a\times\vec b|^2=|\vec a|^2|\vec b|^2-(\vec a\cdot\vec b)^2=4\cdot36-(-9)^2=63\).

questions.prompt: Find the position vector of the midpoint of \(A(3, -3, 2)\) and \(B(7, -7, 6)\).
questions.explanation: Midpoint \(=\dfrac{\vec a+\vec b}{2}=\dfrac{(10, -10, 8)}{2}=5\hat i-5\hat j+4\hat k\).

questions.prompt: Find the coefficient of \(\hat i\) in \(\vec a\times\vec b\) when \(\vec a=-2\hat i-3\hat j+2\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\hat i-4\hat j+\hat k\).
questions.explanation: \(\vec a\times\vec b=5\hat i+4\hat j+11\hat k\); the coefficient of \(\hat i\) is \(5\). (For \(\hat j\) remember the minus sign in the determinant.)

questions.prompt: A force of magnitude 10 N acts on a body and displaces it by 10 m. The angle between the force and the displacement is \(0^\circ\). Find the work done in joules.
questions.explanation: \(W=Fd\cos\theta=10\times10\times\cos0^\circ=100\) J.

questions.prompt: Find \(|\vec r|\) when \(\vec r=-2\hat i+4\hat j+6\hat k\).
Find the volume of the parallelepiped with adjacent edges \(\vec a=-\hat i+3\hat j+2\hat k\), \(\vec b=2\hat i+2\hat k\), \(\vec c=2\hat j-2\hat k\).
questions.explanation: Volume \(=|\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c|\). The determinant is \(24\); volume (never negative) \(=24\) cubic units.

questions.prompt: Which vector is parallel to \(\vec a=4\hat i+\hat j+3\hat k\)?
questions.explanation: Parallel vectors are scalar multiples: \(\vec b=k\vec a\). Only \(-12\hat i-3\hat j-9\hat k=-3\vec a\) has all three ratios equal to \(-3\).

questions.prompt: Find the area of the triangle with vertices \(A(2, -2, 0)\), \(B(2, 4, -1)\), \(C(2, 1, 4)\).
questions.explanation: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=6\hat j-\hat k\), \(\overrightarrow{AC}=3\hat j+4\hat k\); \(\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}=27\hat i\). Area \(=\tfrac12|\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}|=\tfrac12\sqrt{729}=\frac{27}{2}\).

questions.prompt: Find the unit vector in the direction of \(\vec a=-\hat i+8\hat j+4\hat k\).
questions.explanation: \(|\vec a|=9\), so \(\hat a=\dfrac{\vec a}{|\vec a|}=\dfrac{1}{9}(-\hat i+8\hat j+4\hat k)=-\frac{1}{9}\hat i+\frac{8}{9}\hat j+\frac{4}{9}\hat k\).

questions.prompt: Find the area of the triangle with vertices \(A(-4, 3, -3)\), \(B(0, 3, 3)\), \(C(2, -3, 4)\).
questions.explanation: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=4\hat i+6\hat k\), \(\overrightarrow{AC}=6\hat i-6\hat j+7\hat k\); \(\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}=36\hat i+8\hat j-24\hat k\). Area \(=\tfrac12|\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}|=\tfrac12\sqrt{1936}=22\).

questions.prompt: Which statement about \(\vec a\times\vec b\) and the plane of \(\vec a,\vec b\) is correct?
questions.explanation: It is perpendicular to both vectors, hence normal to their plane.

options: \(\vec a\times\vec b\) is normal to the plane
\(\vec a\times\vec b\) is parallel to \(\vec b\)
\(\vec a\times\vec b\) is parallel to \(\vec a\)
\(\vec a\times\vec b\) lies in the plane

questions.prompt: Find \(\lambda\) so that \(-2\hat i-3\hat j+\lambda\hat k\) is perpendicular to \(3\hat i-4\hat j+2\hat k\).
questions.explanation: Perpendicular \(\Leftrightarrow\) dot product \(=0\): \(-2(3)+(-3)(-4)+\lambda(2)=0\Rightarrow\lambda=-3\).

questions.prompt: Find the direction cosines \((l, m, n)\) of \(\vec r=10\hat i-5\hat j+10\hat k\).
Find \(\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c\) for \(\vec a=-\hat j-2\hat k\), \(\vec b=3\hat i-2\hat j\), \(\vec c=2\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k\).
questions.explanation: \(\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c=\begin{vmatrix}0&-1&-2\\3&-2&0\\2&2&1\end{vmatrix}=-17\).

questions.prompt: \(ABCD\) is a parallelogram (vertices in this order) with \(A(1, -5, -5)\), \(B(-2, 0, 0)\), \(C(1, 1, 3)\). Find \(D\).
questions.explanation: The diagonals bisect each other, so \(\dfrac{\vec a+\vec c}{2}=\dfrac{\vec b+\vec d}{2}\) and \(\vec d=\vec a+\vec c-\vec b=4\hat i-4\hat j-2\hat k\).

questions.prompt: A boat heads due east at 24 km/h in still water while a river current flows due north at 45 km/h. Find the speed of the boat relative to the ground (km/h).
questions.explanation: The two velocities are perpendicular, so the resultant speed is \(\sqrt{24^2+45^2}=\sqrt{2601}=51\) km/h.

questions.prompt: If \([\vec a\ \vec b\ \vec c]=-8\), find \([\vec a\ \vec c\ \vec b]\).
questions.explanation: A cyclic shift of the three vectors keeps the sign; swapping any two vectors changes the sign; a repeated vector makes the value \(0\).

questions.prompt: \(\vec a=2\hat i-2\hat j+2\hat k\), \(\vec b=-2\hat j-3\hat k\). The angle between them is
questions.explanation: \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=-2\). Positive dot product \(\Rightarrow\) acute angle, zero \(\Rightarrow\) \(90^\circ\), negative \(\Rightarrow\) obtuse.

questions.prompt: If \(\vec a=3\hat i-4\hat j-4\hat k\) and \(\vec b=2\hat i-4\hat j+2\hat k\), find \(2\vec a+3\vec b\).
questions.explanation: Multiply component by component then add: \(2(3, -4, -4)+3(2, -4, 2)=12\hat i-20\hat j-2\hat k\).

questions.prompt: Find the area of the parallelogram whose adjacent sides are \(\vec a=-2\hat i-4\hat j+3\hat k\) and \(\vec b=-2\hat i+3\hat j-4\hat k\).
questions.explanation: Area \(=|\vec a\times\vec b|\). \(\vec a\times\vec b=7\hat i-14\hat j-14\hat k\), so area \(=\sqrt{441}=21\).

questions.prompt: Find the moment of the force \(\vec F=-2\hat i-\hat j-4\hat k\) acting at the point \(P(-2, -4, 3)\) about the point \(O(1, -2, 1)\).
questions.explanation: \(\vec r=\overrightarrow{OP}=P-O=-3\hat i-2\hat j+2\hat k\); \(\vec M=\vec r\times\vec F=10\hat i-16\hat j-\hat k\). (Order matters: \(\vec r\) first, then \(\vec F\).)

questions.prompt: Find the area of the triangle with vertices \(A(2, -2, 2)\), \(B(4, -4, -1)\), \(C(-2, -4, 2)\).
questions.explanation: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=2\hat i-2\hat j-3\hat k\), \(\overrightarrow{AC}=-4\hat i-2\hat j\); \(\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}=-6\hat i+12\hat j-12\hat k\). Area \(=\tfrac12|\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}|=\tfrac12\sqrt{324}=9\).

questions.prompt: Find the position vector of the midpoint of \(A(-2, -2, 0)\) and \(B(4, 2, 2)\).
questions.explanation: Midpoint \(=\dfrac{\vec a+\vec b}{2}=\dfrac{(2, 0, 2)}{2}=\hat i+\hat k\).

questions.prompt: A vector makes angles \(45^\circ\) and \(60^\circ\) with the \(x\)- and \(y\)-axes. Find the angle it makes with the \(z\)-axis (acute).
questions.explanation: \(\cos^2\alpha+\cos^2\beta+\cos^2\gamma=1\Rightarrow\cos^2\gamma=1-\cos^245^\circ-\cos^260^\circ=\frac{1}{4}\), so \(\gamma=60^\circ\).

questions.prompt: Find the angle between \(\vec a=-2\hat i+2\hat k\) and \(\vec b=-2\hat i-2\hat j\).
questions.explanation: \(\cos\theta=\dfrac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec a||\vec b|}=\dfrac{4}{2 \sqrt{2}\cdot 2 \sqrt{2}}=\frac{1}{2}\), so \(\theta=60^\circ\).

questions.prompt: If \(|\vec a|=6\), \(|\vec b|=5\) and the angle between them is \(60^\circ\), find \(|\vec a-\vec b|\).
questions.explanation: \(|\vec a-\vec b|^2=|\vec a|^2-2\vec a\cdot\vec b+|\vec b|^2=36-2(15)+25=31\), so \(|\vec a-\vec b|=\sqrt{31}\).

questions.prompt: Find the volume of the tetrahedron with vertices \(A(-1, -3, 3)\), \(B(-1, -3, 5)\), \(C(-4, -2, 3)\), \(D(-2, -6, 2)\).
questions.explanation: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=2\hat k\), \(\overrightarrow{AC}=-3\hat i+\hat j\), \(\overrightarrow{AD}=-\hat i-3\hat j-\hat k\); determinant \(=20\). Volume \(=\tfrac16|20|=\frac{10}{3}\).

questions.prompt: For which value of \(t\) are \(A(4, -2, -3)\), \(B(6, -5, -4)\) and \(C(2, 1, t)\) collinear?
questions.explanation: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=2\hat i-3\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\overrightarrow{AC}\) must be parallel to it. The first two components give \(\overrightarrow{AC}=-1\,\overrightarrow{AB}\), so \(t=z_A+-1(-1)=-2\).

questions.prompt: Which vector is parallel to \(\vec a=\hat i-4\hat j-2\hat k\)?
questions.explanation: Parallel vectors are scalar multiples: \(\vec b=k\vec a\). Only \(-2\hat i+8\hat j+4\hat k=-2\vec a\) has all three ratios equal to \(-2\).

questions.prompt: Find the area of the parallelogram whose adjacent sides are \(\vec a=4\hat i+2\hat k\) and \(\vec b=-2\hat i+\hat k\).
questions.explanation: Area \(=|\vec a\times\vec b|\). \(\vec a\times\vec b=-8\hat j\), so area \(=\sqrt{64}=8\).

questions.prompt: Find the unit vector in the direction of \(\vec a=10\hat i-20\hat j-20\hat k\).
questions.explanation: \(|\vec a|=30\), so \(\hat a=\dfrac{\vec a}{|\vec a|}=\dfrac{1}{30}(10\hat i-20\hat j-20\hat k)=\frac{1}{3}\hat i-\frac{2}{3}\hat j-\frac{2}{3}\hat k\).

questions.prompt: If \(|\vec a|=14\), find \(|-3\vec a|\).
questions.explanation: \(|k\vec a|=|k|\,|\vec a|=|-3|\cdot 14=42\). A negative scalar only reverses the direction; magnitude is never negative.

questions.prompt: A force of 10 N is applied at a distance of 3 m from a hinge. The angle between the force and the line from the hinge to the point of application is \(150^\circ\). Find the magnitude of the moment (N m).

questions.prompt: Find the position vector of the centroid of the triangle with vertices \(A(1, -3, 5)\), \(B(5, -2, 2)\), \(C(3, -4, 2)\).
